name: checkbox
description: A binary selection control used to toggle an option on or off, with optional description text.

invalid.notes: Uses [&[aria-invalid]] compound selector to beat data-[state=open]/focus-visible specificity. Blue ring must NOT appear when invalid.

accessibility.screenReaderName: Visible label text is the accessible name.
accessibility.focusIndicator: color/ring stroke, 2px outside, on checkbox-item and checkbox-box.
accessibility.touchTarget: Visual box is 16x16px; implementation should make the full row at least 44px high.

constraints: Use checkbox-item in forms and settings.
Use checkbox-box standalone only inside a custom labeled row.
Indeterminate is programmatic and represents partial child selection.
Checked Disabled is for pre-selected locked values.
Do not use checkbox-box State=Focus to represent checked selection.

useCases: Accept terms and conditions — a single required consent field at the bottom of a form
File manager or media library: selecting multiple items for bulk actions (delete, move, download)
Notification preferences list: Email updates, SMS alerts, Weekly digest — check any combination
Filter panels: selecting multiple categories, tags, or attributes to refine a list
Settings screen: display preferences where each option is independent and submitted with a Save action

Description=False.whenToUse: Short, self-explanatory option labels — no clarification needed

Description=True.whenToUse: Option needs a supporting line to clarify scope or consequence
examples: Marketing emails — Receive news and promotions
Two-factor auth — Adds an extra sign-in step

comparedTo.situation: User selects multiple items from a list in a form (submitted on Save)
Single mandatory consent in a form (I agree to the terms)
Effect should apply immediately on toggle, no submit button
User picks exactly one option from a visible short list (2–5)
User must pick one or more from a long searchable list

openQuestions: Checkbox.md Token Bindings says Invalid text uses color/text/invalid, while Behavior says color/status/danger-subtle/foreground. Confirm the correct token.
notes: Examples assume a CheckboxItem wrapper around shadcn Checkbox.

R8 reviewed 2026-05-28: fills on the checkbox-box instance root are intentional — this is standard Figma composition. Sub-component State props corrected (Hover/Checked/Indeterminate/Disabled/Checked Disabled now point to correct variant).

changelog.change: Invalid state: focus ring uses color/border/error instead of color/ring.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.
